jobs.occupation: KØKKEN SOUSCHEF SØGES TIL SPISEHUSET DRAGØR SEJLKLUB
jobs.description:
Spisehuset Dragør Sejlklub søger en erfaren og ansvarsbevidst køkken souschef til en fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen.

Om restauranten

Spisehuset Dragør Sejlklub ligger ved Dragør Havn i en historisk bygning fra 1863. Restauranten har fokus på god mad, god service og en hyggelig atmosfære. Køkkenet står for den daglige restaurantdrift samt selskaber og arrangementer, og der er derfor fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet og godt samarbejde i køkkenet.

Som køkken souschef bliver du en central del af den daglige køkkendrift og arbejder tæt sammen med køkkenchefen og det øvrige køkkenpersonale. Stillingen indebærer både praktisk køkkenarbejde samt ansvar for koordinering og ledelse af køkkenpersonalet.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

• 
Assistere køkkenchefen med den daglige ledelse og koordinering

• 
Varetage køkkendriften ved køkkenchefens fravær

• 
Fordele og koordinere arbejdsopgaver blandt køkkenpersonalet

• 
Planlægge mise en place og øvrig forberedelse

• 
Deltage aktivt i madlavning og produktion

• 
Sikre kvalitet, smag og ensartethed i retterne

• 
Oplære og vejlede nye medarbejdere

• 
Medvirke til planlægning af bemanding og arbejdsflow

• 
Kontrollere varemodtagelse, lager og råvareforbrug

• 
Sikre overholdelse af hygiejne- og fødevaresikkerhedsregler

• 
Bidrage til en effektiv drift under både almindelig service og selskaber

Vi søger dig, der

• 
Har relevant erfaring fra et professionelt køkken

• 
Har erfaring som souschef, køkkenansvarlig, teamleder eller tilsvarende

• 
Har erfaring med koordinering eller ledelse af køkkenpersonale

• 
Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for køkkendriften

• 
Er struktureret, stabil og ansvarsbevidst

• 
Kan bevare overblikket under travle services

• 
Har fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet og fødevaresikkerhed

• 
Kan kommunikere på engelsk. Dansk er en fordel.

Vi tilbyder

• 
Fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen

• 
En central rolle med ansvar for den daglige køkkendrift

• 
Tæt samarbejde med køkkenchef og øvrigt personale

• 
Varierende arbejdsopgaver inden for restaurant- og selskabsdrift

• 
Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling

• 
Løn efter erfaring og kvalifikationer

• 
Ansættelse på almindelige danske vilkår

Arbejdstiden kan omfatte dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.

ENGLISH

KITCHEN SOUS CHEF WANTED FOR SPISEHUSET DRAGØR SEJLKLUB

Spisehuset Dragør Sejlklub is looking for an experienced and responsible Kitchen Sous Chef for a permanent full-time position of 37 hours per week.

About the restaurant

Spisehuset Dragør Sejlklub is located at Dragør Harbour in a historic building dating from 1863. The restaurant focuses on good food, good service and a welcoming atmosphere. The kitchen is responsible for daily restaurant service as well as private functions and events, with a strong focus on quality, efficiency and teamwork.

As Kitchen Sous Chef, you will play a central role in the daily kitchen operation and work closely with the Head Chef and the rest of the kitchen team. The position includes both practical kitchen work and responsibility for coordinating and supervising kitchen staff.

Main responsibilities

• 
Assist the Head Chef with the daily management and coordination of the kitchen

• 
Take responsibility for the kitchen operation when the Head Chef is absent

• 
Distribute and coordinate tasks among kitchen staff

• 
Plan mise en place and other preparation

• 
Take an active part in cooking and food production

• 
Ensure quality, taste and consistency of dishes

• 
Train and guide new employees

• 
Assist with staffing and workflow planning

• 
Monitor deliveries, stock and ingredient usage

• 
Ensure compliance with food hygiene and food safety requirements

• 
Contribute to efficient operations during both regular service and private functions

About you

• 
Relevant professional kitchen experience

• 
Experience as a Sous Chef, Kitchen Supervisor, Team Leader or similar

• 
Experience coordinating or supervising kitchen staff

• 
Able to work independently and take responsibility for kitchen operations

• 
Organised, reliable and responsible

• 
Able to remain calm during busy services

• 
Focused on quality, efficiency and food safety

• 
Able to communicate in English. Danish is an advantage.

We offer

• 
Permanent full-time position of 37 hours per week

• 
A central role with responsibility for daily kitchen operations

• 
Close cooperation with the Head Chef and kitchen team

• 
Varied duties within restaurant and private-function operations

• 
Opportunities for professional and personal development

• 
Salary based on experience and qualifications

• 
Employment on ordinary Danish terms

Working hours may include daytime, evening and weekend shifts.

jobs.description:
CE-Licensed Drivers Wanted for Night and Evening Shifts

FragtDK ApS is experiencing increased demand and is therefore looking for 2–4 new, experienced, and reliable drivers holding a Category CE driving licence.

Shifts typically run from 5:00 PM to 3:00 AM. You will become part of a small, close-knit team of drivers with an informal working environment, while maintaining a strong focus on safety and proper planning.

We are based at Hovedgaden 429 in Hedehusene. As a driver with us, you will operate heavy vehicles on routes primarily in and around Greater Copenhagen, as well as on longer-distance routes.

The work will be varied, but you must be prepared for the majority of the driving to take place at night. You must also be willing to stay overnight in the vehicle when necessary.

The positions are full-time.

We expect that you:

• 
Hold a valid Category CE driving licence

• 
Have solid experience as a truck driver – preferably 10 years or more – within distribution or transport of a similar nature

• 
Have experience driving 25.25-metre modular vehicle combinations (link combinations)

• 
Are flexible and able to work evening and night shifts

• 
Are prepared for the majority of the driving to take place at night and to stay overnight in the vehicle when necessary

• 
Speak and understand English at a level that allows you to communicate confidently with colleagues and customers

• 
Can provide a clean criminal record certificate and hold a driving licence with no current sanctions or restrictions

• 
Holding licences for other types of heavy vehicles is an advantage, but not a requirement

In return, we offer:

• 
Fixed shifts with predictable working hours

• 
Salary based on qualifications

• 
A good and friendly working environment at FragtDK ApS

If you have any questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact us at info@fragtdk.com.

Please send your application and CV to the same email address no later than two weeks after the publication of this job advertisement.

Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and the positions will be filled as soon as we find the right candidates.

Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The immersion engineering team is looking for a naval architect, maritime engineer or offshore engineer to strengthen the team. Immersion engineering is taking care of all calculations regarding tunnel elements float up (weight analysis, determine ballast concrete and water, longitudinal section forces, floating stability), transfers in basins and harbor (winch operations with or without vessel assistance), mooring of the tunnel elements, transport to offshore location, immersion (including but not limited to dynamic analyses) and the stability of the elements after immersion.

As an Immersion Engineer, you will participate in the team responsible for floating up and/or hoisting the concrete tunnel elements, equipping them in the port and then transporting and installing them at sea. In the first phase you will participate in the preparation of this crucial operation, by making ballast plans e.g.. In the second phase, you will be part of the operational team that does the immersion work, assisting the Immersion Master by giving technical advice.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

• 
During the preparatory phase, you are responsible for the ballast plans and float up calculations.

• 
You take part in the interface management with other departments within FLC regarding specific parts of the T&I scope

• 
You will coordinate part of the design scope between Work Preparations and the design team based in the Netherlands

• 
You are involved in the management/operation of Tunnel Control Systems

• 
You ensure the conclusions and results from the design documents are correctly taken over in the work method statements, drawings and operation manuals for the Immersion Pontoon specific operations related to the overall transport and immersion scope

• 
You liaise with the Marine Warranty Surveyor and contribute to the work procedures, Go/No Go procedures

• 
During float up and ballasting you check if the operations stay within boundary conditions and act accordingly

• 
During the execution phase, you advise during the transport and installation of the elements. You will be present in the command unit of the immersion pontoons during offshore operations.

• 
You will do checks during execution, monitor the immersion process, and have an advisory role to the one in charge of the operation. You are also prepared and ready to deal with contingencies if any might occur

• 
After immersion, you will do checks on data to create lessons learned for next operations

Qualifications:

• 
You are a qualified naval architect/maritime engineer/offshore engineer with minimum of 7 years experience

• 
You have prior experience with immersion of large structures or offshore lifting operations

• 
You have a good understanding of stability calculations, mooring calculations and hydrodynamics

• 
You are a hands-on problem solver and a decision maker

• 
You are a team player with strong communication skills

• 
You find it a challenge to work in a international, multi-cultural work-environment in which communication and team spirit is key to success

• 
You are fluent in English.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company.

Full time employment with health insurance and lunch arrangement available upon request.

Workplace:

Based in Rødbyhavn.

Application:

We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible and. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.

Salary and employment conditions

Job titleSenior Sourcing SpecialistJob description:
At BeGreen, we develop and operate renewable energy projects built to last across generations. 

We are looking for a commercially driven Senior Sourcing Specialist with a strong background in renewables to lead sourcing activities and commercial contracting across solar, hybrid, and energy storage projects based in Denmark, with exposure to international suppliers and projects. 

This position is ideal for someone who understands the unique sourcing and commercial challenges of renewable energy, whether in solar, BESS, or hybrid technologies—and who knows that the right supplier relationships and contracts are what make or break a project. Broader experience in energy infrastructure, construction, or adjacent industries is equally welcome, and will add valuable perspective to our team. 

About the role 

You will take ownership of sourcing strategies, supplier engagement, and contract execution across the full renewable energy project lifecycle. Working closely with Project Management, Engineering, Construction, Sustainability, Cyber Security, HSE, and Legal, you will ensure that commercial decisions drive project performance and long-term value. 

Your hands-on knowledge of the renewables market—its key suppliers, technology trends, cost drivers, and contractual complexities—will be a distinct advantage in this role. Whether you're navigating a large EPC tender for a solar park, structuring a BESS supply agreement, or evaluating a new contractor in an emerging market, your sector insight will be central to how you work. 

Beyond large and complex tenders, you will also support pragmatic sourcing for lower-value purchases, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and speed without compromising quality or governance. 

Key responsibilities 

• Lead end-to-end competitive tenders for major renewable energy packages, including planning, evaluation, negotiation, and contract award 
• Develop and execute sourcing strategies specifically tailored to solar parks, hybrid plants, and battery energy storage systems 
• Leverage renewables market knowledge to drive supplier assessments, benchmark pricing, and identify strategic sourcing opportunities 
• Lead commercial negotiations with energy suppliers and contractors, with a strong focus on risk management and contract robustness 
• Manage both complex, high-value sourcing processes and agile lower-value purchasing activities (RFQs, call-offs, POs) 
• Prepare decision-making materials, including total cost of ownership analyses with a clear understanding of energy project cost structures 
• Support early contract management, including supplier onboarding, performance tracking, and risk assessments 
• Contribute market intelligence on renewable energy supply chains to strengthen category strategies and long-term supplier partnerships 
What you bring 

We are looking for someone with a solid commercial background, and we particularly value: 

• Direct sourcing or commercial experience in solar, BESS, hybrid energy, wind or other renewable technologies 
• Familiarity with key renewable energy suppliers, EPC contractors, and technology providers 
• Understanding of the commercial and technical dynamics specific to utility-scale renewable projects 
 Broader energy & infrastructure experience (also highly valued): 

• Experience in conventional energy, oil & gas, transmission, or large-scale infrastructure procurement 
• Background in complex project environments with multi-stakeholder commercial interfaces 
• Exposure to long-term contracts, framework agreements, and supplier performance management 
In addition, you bring: 

• Confidence in leading negotiations and managing commercial interfaces
• A structured, proactive, and ownership-driven approach to work
• Strong stakeholder management and clear communication skills
• Knowledge of EU procurement regulations (Utilities Directive) or the motivation to build it
• Fluency in English; proficiency in Danish or Swedish is a plus
• Relocation packages are not available for this role and a valid Danish work- and residence permit is a precondition
The team you will join 

You will join BeGreen's Procurement team, a group of specialists working across category management, sourcing, and contract management. We collaborate closely, share knowledge openly, and prioritize integrity in both processes and relationships.  

 

What we offer 

• A key role in shaping sourcing practices at a fast-growing renewable energy company 
• Influence across the full project lifecycle—from early development through construction to operations 
• A collaborative, international work environment with passionate and ambitious colleagues 
• A strong focus on professional development and continuous learning 
• Office based in Carlsberg Byen, Copenhagen.  

About BeGreen 

BeGreen develops, builds, and operates onshore energy facilities – primarily solar, wind, and battery solutions. We are around 60 colleagues from diverse backgrounds. We design our projects to work in practice – technically, commercially, and in interaction with local communities. 

BeGreen is headquartered in Denmark and is part of Equinor, an international energy company. This provides a strong foundation and access to experience and competencies across markets. 

Our values: collaboration, integrity and ambition are applied to our projects, decisions, and the way we work together internally and externally.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Welder / Tack Welder for Weekend Day Shift
jobs.description:
Do you have solid experience in welding and tack welding, and do you thrive in a structured environment with clear expectations and a strong focus on quality and precision? At Give Steel A/S, you will become an important part of our weekend day shift production team, where your contribution helps ensure strong, documented steel structures.

Why Choose Us?

You will become part of a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company with a strong focus on quality, safety, and responsible production. We are committed to employee development and offer a workplace with freedom under responsibility, well-organised working conditions, and opportunities for professional growth.

You will be employed under the Danish Collective Agreement for the Industry Sector (Industriens Overenskomst). In addition, we offer private health insurance and the option to join our canteen scheme.

What Will Your Workday Look Like?

You will join a team manufacturing load-bearing steel structures and steel trusses. The work is carried out on the weekend day shift, where you will follow established work procedures and contribute to ensuring tasks are completed safely, efficiently, and to a high standard of quality.

Your working hours will be from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Tack welding and welding steel structures based on technical drawings and work instructions

• Preparing components and checking measurements, fit, and quality

• Carrying out tasks with a systematic and thorough approach

• Contributing to strong teamwork with colleagues in production

• Complying with all applicable safety, quality, and documentation requirements

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for an experienced and reliable employee who works in a structured and detail-oriented manner. You thrive in a well-defined environment, can maintain an overview in a busy production setting, and take pride in delivering lasting, high-quality results.

We expect that you:

• Have solid experience as a welder and/or tack welder

• Work thoroughly, responsibly, and with a strong focus on quality

• Can read and understand technical drawings

• Are reliable and a team player

• Contribute positively to a professional and safe working environment

• Speak Danish and/or English

• Live in Denmark within a reasonable commuting distance of Brande

We can provide certification in various welding methods, so it is not important whether you already hold welding certificates.

Interested?

If you have any questions about the position, please contact our Head of Production, Tomas Slepavicius, at tsl@givesteel.com.

We would like to receive your CV, clearly outlining your relevant experience. We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible, and we will remove the job advertisement once the position has been filled.

About Give Steel A/S

Give Steel A/S is a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company that develops, designs, manufactures, and erects load-bearing steel structures and steel trusses. Quality, safety, and documentation are an integral part of our daily operations, while we also maintain a strong focus on CO₂ reduction and responsible production.

You will become part of an international company with strong technical expertise and opportunities for professional development. Collaboration, responsibility, and integrity are key values in our daily work.
